method: Loss-minimized measurement projection of R3 computed JSON; no HTML, screenshots, font or media bytes. Source viewport 1440x900 / 390x844; R3 rolled pages for lazy-load. Selectors may include hidden or unhydrated nodes: visibility retained, not promoted to actual rendered fonts.
scopeNote: Root custom properties are NOT the inherited body/page theme; root --body-bg #fff must not be read as actual page background. Style projections retain at most five unique treatments per query role, not all page text.
